bundle.shortDescription: Ground control station for ArduPilot and PX4 vehicles
bundle.longDescription: MPCraft is a ground control station for ArduPilot and PX4: live telemetry, mission planning, parameter configuration, log analysis and firmware tools, in one application on Windows, Linux and macOS.
